colorPrompt: Compose one children's book picture from the element pictures. Picture 2 shows the same girl from the front and is for her colors and her look only: black-brown hair in two buns with red hair ties, large dark-brown eyes with white highlights, an orange T-shirt with a white star. Do NOT copy the front view of picture 2 and do NOT turn her face toward the camera: the picture to make is a pure side view like picture 1. Keep the soft, round, bright 3D render look of the pictures, not a 2D drawing and no outlines. The picture: a square close picture of Nan's head and the top of her shoulders in an exact side view (90 degrees). Her face looks to the right edge of the picture. The nose tip is the most forward point of the face outline and stands out clearly as a small round nose in profile, with the bridge of the nose and the nostril clearly seen. Only ONE eye shows (the near eye): it is big, dark brown, with white highlights and one short thick curved eyelash flick. The far eye is not seen at all: no sliver of a second eye shows at the edge of the face. The ear is smooth with one clean rounded rim. One hair bun with its red hair tie shows on the top of the head. She smiles gently, with the mouth in profile. The head and the top of the shoulders fill the square. Her hands are not in the picture. The background is plain white and empty. The page text is context only: do not draw any text. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. The picture is for young children and is rated G. The ears are smooth, with one clean rounded rim. Each piece of clothing is one even color with no pale patches or stains. There is no line or crease on the forehead. A hanging hand shows relaxed, separate small fingers. The picture is a TIGHT crop: the lower edge of the picture cuts straight through the shoulders just below the neck, so only the head, the neck, and the very top of the shoulders and T-shirt show. The head fills most of the square, as large as possible, in the middle of the picture. No arm and no hand are in the picture, and no hard cut edge of the T-shirt floats in the picture.
